metadata.business_objective: Increase 30-day Wishlist-to-Purchase conversion on Myntra without monetary incentives.

themes.evidence_summary: Customers express anxiety regarding sizing variance across brands (Roadster vs HRX vs Zara) and uncertainty around fabric drape on non-model body types. (957 reviews, 60.8% of analyzed corpus).
observed_facts: Sizing varies drastically across fast-fashion and D2C brands on Myntra.
Shoppers lack visual proof of how garments fit on real people matching their height and weight.
themes.observed_behavior: Shoppers repeatedly report that Brand A Size M fits like Brand B Size L. Lack of cross-brand calibration induces checkout paralysis.
themes.behavioral_mechanism: Sizing variance across fast-fashion labels triggers return anxiety, converting immediate purchase impulses into 6-hour off-platform delay.
themes.underlying_need: Confidence that the chosen size will fit their exact body frame without needing a size exchange.
themes.barrier_or_driver: Barrier: Sizing ambiguity across distinct brand cuts.
themes.confidence_explanation: High confidence based on 957 customer reviews across 3 sources (play_store, app_store, reddit) directly impacting wishlist conversion.
alternative_explanations: Users may be waiting for size restocks.
themes.contradictory_evidence: Positive reviews report accurate fit when exact biometric dimensions are specified.
themes.product_opportunity: Surfacing an inline Brand Size Delta (e.g. Zara M → Roadster S) directly on native wishlist cards eliminates sizing doubt in <45s.
themes.research_hypothesis: If shoppers see verified cross-brand size calibration deltas directly on native wishlist cards, 30-day Wishlist-to-Purchase conversion will increase by +2.70pp (+31.8% rel) with ₹0 discount spend.
research_questions: How do shoppers calibrate their size when buying a new apparel brand on Myntra?
What specific body dimensions (shoulders, chest, height) drive the highest return anxiety?
themes.why_these_quotes_matter: Demonstrates that fit anxiety is an evaluation friction, not a lack of interest.
assumptions: Users know their basic height and benchmark sizes in Zara/H&M.
themes.reasoning_trace: 957 review mentions (60.8% of friction corpus) across fast-fashion topwear; corroborated by 26 of 35 survey respondents (74.3%).

themes.suggested_insight: If users see verified UGC photos from reviewers matching their height and body profile with definitive size advice calibrated to their Zara/H&M benchmarks, 30-day Wishlist-to-Purchase conversion will increase by 18-24% without discounting.
themes.suggested_research_question: Tell me about the last time you saved an apparel item to your Myntra wishlist but didn't buy it—what specific sizing or drape doubts made you hesitate?

themes.evidence_summary: Shoppers express concern that studio lighting hides fabric thinness, synthetic textures, or exact colors. (223 reviews, 14.2% of analyzed corpus).
observed_facts: Catalog imagery uses high-end studio lighting that obscures fabric texture and transparency.
Shoppers seek unedited UGC photos taken in natural daylight.
themes.observed_behavior: Users inspect reviews repeatedly searching for customer photos before deciding to buy.
themes.behavioral_mechanism: Information asymmetry between polished brand imagery and physical textile reality creates risk aversion.
themes.underlying_need: Authentic, unfiltered customer photos showing fabric in natural lighting.
themes.barrier_or_driver: Barrier: Distrust of studio product renders.
themes.confidence_explanation: High confidence based on 223 customer reviews across 2 sources (play_store, app_store) directly impacting wishlist conversion.
alternative_explanations: Users may prefer offline trial for premium fabrics.
themes.contradictory_evidence: Positive reviews praise natural cotton/linen textures when verified with photos.
themes.product_opportunity: Embed authentic verified customer try-on photos directly into wishlist card evaluation modals.
themes.research_hypothesis: Displaying high-confidence UGC review photos within the wishlist modal will neutralize quality doubt.
research_questions: What textile attributes most frequently disappoint online fashion shoppers?
themes.why_these_quotes_matter: Shows the role of authentic UGC in establishing product truth.
assumptions: Sufficient volume of verified reviews with photos exist for top SKUs.
themes.reasoning_trace: Fabric Doubt -> Authenticity Gap -> Wishlist Stagnation

themes.evidence_summary: Shoppers love wishlisted items but struggle to conceptualize how to pair them with clothes and shoes they already own. (56 reviews, 3.6% of analyzed corpus).
observed_facts: Shoppers save jackets, shirts, and shoes but hesitate because they are unsure what bottomwear/footwear to wear them with.
Catalog studio photos show full curated outfits, but users don't know if the item pairs with their existing closet.
themes.observed_behavior: Shoppers retain items in wishlist for weeks seeking external styling validation on Reddit/Instagram.
themes.behavioral_mechanism: Isolation anxiety: Standalone apparel has low perceived utility unless connected to a complete wearable outfit.
themes.underlying_need: Immediate visualization of the wishlisted SKU styled with items from the user's past 12-month Myntra orders.
themes.barrier_or_driver: Barrier: Mental friction in constructing outfits from disjointed purchases.
themes.confidence_explanation: Medium confidence based on 56 customer reviews in play_store, app_store, reddit.
alternative_explanations: Users might prefer buying complete matching sets.
themes.contradictory_evidence: Shoppers with staple-heavy wardrobes convert faster.
themes.product_opportunity: Automatically generate a Wardrobe Lookbook Canvas rendering the wishlisted SKU alongside the user's owned closet items.
themes.research_hypothesis: If wishlisted items are contextualized against past order items with AI color harmony and silhouette rules, users will convert without requiring monetary price drops.
research_questions: How often do users evaluate their existing closet before completing an apparel checkout?
Which categories suffer most from styling hesitation (outerwear, footwear, statement tops)?
themes.why_these_quotes_matter: Proves users abandon wishlists when they cannot visualize complete outfit synergy.
assumptions: Myntra has access to past 12 months of purchase history.
themes.reasoning_trace: Pairing Friction -> Low Mental Utility -> Wishlist Deferral

themes.evidence_summary: Shoppers intentionally use wishlist as a price-tracking holding pen until monthly salaries or seasonal sales. (97 reviews, 6.2% of analyzed corpus).
observed_facts: Shoppers curate baskets 2-3 weeks in advance of payday.
Items remain saved until discount threshold or wallet balance unlocks.
themes.observed_behavior: Passive waiting behavior with periodic app opens to check price alerts.
themes.behavioral_mechanism: Budget constraint budgeting behavior; low immediate urgency.
themes.confidence_explanation: Medium confidence based on 97 customer reviews in play_store, app_store, reddit.
alternative_explanations: Users may buy alternative items if flash sales occur.
themes.contradictory_evidence: Shoppers frequently complete purchases without sales when urgent styling needs arise.
themes.product_opportunity: Provide high-value outfit contextualization to increase perceived utility and justify immediate purchase.
themes.research_hypothesis: No monetary discount hypothesis generated. Price wait can be partially compressed by elevating outfit utility.
research_questions: What proportion of wishlist items are bought at full price vs sale price?
themes.why_these_quotes_matter: Distinguishes price-driven delay from hesitation-driven delay.
assumptions: Payday cycles occur predominantly at end of month.
themes.reasoning_trace: Timing Delay -> External Constraint -> Temporary Inaction

themes.suggested_research_question: What information on a product page most quickly convinces you to move an item from your wishlist to your bag?

themes.evidence_summary: Shoppers report frustration with delivery delays, exchange pickup friction, and courier coordination. (226 reviews, 14.3% of analyzed corpus).
observed_facts: Returns and size exchanges take multiple days to process.
themes.observed_behavior: Complaining on app store reviews regarding delivery agents.
themes.confidence_explanation: Medium confidence based on 226 customer reviews in play_store, app_store.
themes.contradictory_evidence: Most deliveries arrive on time in metro tiers.
themes.research_hypothesis: Operational fulfillment issue routed to logistics teams.
themes.why_these_quotes_matter: Distinguishes pre-purchase conversion blockers from logistics friction.
themes.out_of_scope_reason: Operational logistics issue outside wishlist decision support scope.
